description: Change a deployed agent's name, description, cover or categories, and its settings: timezone (used by scheduled tasks), team session mode, the models used for chat, scheduled tasks and voice calls, and which slash commands are available. Only the fields you pass change. On a running or starting agent, a new name or a setting that changes restarts it to apply the change; a new description, cover or categories, or a setting it already has, leaves it running, and the result says which happened. Calling it with only agent_guid refreshes the setup status of an agent waiting for setup, after its credentials were set. Skills, credentials and custom instructions have their own tools (apply_agent_skills, set_agent_credentials, manage_agent_custom_skill). On a team agent this needs a team admin or the person who deployed it; other team members can read the agent with get_my_agent and message it.

agent_guid.description: The deployed agent's guid, from list_my_agents or deploy_agent.

chat_model.description: Model for chat turns: a slug from the model list in get_my_agent, which shows each model's credits per 1M tokens. null resets to the default. The plan price stays the same.

cover.description: New https cover image URL; null goes back to the template cover.

cron_model.description: Model for scheduled tasks; same rules as chat_model.

enabled_commands.description: Slash commands the agent offers; [] hides all of them. Commands today: agent_help, new_session, agent_status, agent_limits, last_scan, last_heartbeat, agent_restart, clear_all_sessions, clear_history.

team_session_mode.description: private gives each person their own chat history; collaborative shares one history in team chats.

timezone.description: IANA timezone such as "Europe/Istanbul" for scheduled tasks; null or "UTC" means UTC.

voice_postcall_model.description: Model that summarizes voice calls; same rules as chat_model.

voice_prep_model.description: Model that prepares voice calls; same rules as chat_model.

name: update_agent

monthly.description: The monthly credits this period grants. A plan change inside a period moves it for the time left, so it can differ from renewal.

renewal.description: The monthly credits each renewal grants.

notWritten.description: The starter task whose text was never written. It does not run, even when it shows on, until its text is saved with manage_agent_custom_skill.

offSkills.description: While skillOff is true, the skills that end the pause, as lists: turn on one skill from each list. The task then runs while the services it needs are connected.

ownerSkills.description: The skills that bring this task.

skillOff.description: The task is paused because the skills it needs are off: it does not run, even when it shows on, until one skill from each list in offSkills is turned on with apply_agent_skills. Its own on/off state, text and schedule stay as they are.

extraCreditPacks.description: The extra credit packs this plan can buy. Only an active Pro plan can buy them, so any other plan lists none.

lastActivityAt.description: When the agent's newest message was written, on any channel, scheduled runs included. Left out when it has none.

notWritten.description: The starter task whose text was never written. It does not run, even when it shows on, until its text is saved with manage_agent_custom_skill.

offSkills.description: While skillOff is true, the skills that end the pause, as lists: turn on one skill from each list. The task then runs while the services it needs are connected.

ownerSkills.description: The skills that bring this task.

skillOff.description: The task is paused because the skills it needs are off: it does not run, even when it shows on, until one skill from each list in offSkills is turned on with apply_agent_skills. Its own on/off state, text and schedule stay as they are.

setupRequired.description: Whether the agent waits for setup. list_my_agents goes by the status (6). get_my_agent also checks each required credential and names what is missing.

amountUsd.description: What the plan costs every 30 days. For a plan that has ended, the agent's monthly price, which is what a renew charges.

atPeriodEnd.description: For an active plan, what happens at periodEndsAt: it renews, it ends, or unknown for a card plan whose renewal is managed in the Wiro dashboard.
